name: Damanhur
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: An official Ministry of Finance directory lists the Damanhur real-estate registration office and a Damanhur registry unit in Beheira. The Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) describes its role in ownership maps and property records and offers digital maps through a written request/quotation/payment process. This confirms local record/map institutions, but not open vector data.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a separate city cadastral viewer or public service API exists; whether any anonymous full polygon is available at the WUP center; formal CRS/native parcel-ID schema.
scopeLimits: The WUP locator is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity. No citywide completeness is asserted. No owner/address/account/token values retained. At most three complete native parcel geometries may be retained for this city; none was obtained.
